data.name: Marine Terror
data.description: A sea reaver can hold her breath for a number of rounds equal to four times her Constitution score (currently %1 rounds). In addition, a sea reaver can move normally though squares of standing water or bog that is 1 foot deep. It does not cost her extra movement to traverse these terrains. Lastly, a sea reaver ignores the normal cover bonus to AC when attacking creatures that are partially immersed in water. This ability replaces fast movement.|CONSCORE*4
